label: Appendix A failure RATES (09; 0d recheck items 1-7): failed / launched honest RUNS per world x set x arm; keys and counts only; POST HOC; PRELIMINARY until 0d's recheck

definitions.failure: a launched honest run that ended without a usable scored run because of an error: a sample error of any class, an infrastructure error, or a failure of unknown cause. NOT a failure: a pool rule (paired-pool rule; non-membership by pool rule), a completed run without rows and without an error (structural no-row), and a run that is 'stopped' only in the manifest (its own log: status success, no sample error; 0d item 4), listed apart.
definitions.categories: setup (0 model events), mid-run model error (EmptyPolicyCompletionError / OutputContractError), infrastructure (rate limit), other error (unclassified, model events > 0), unknown cause.
definitions.unit: runs (attempts) on both sides: real = honest_a and honest_b runs; sim = sim_honest runs (failed attempts per cell from its manifest rows)

pool_level_loss.rule: a failed run's cell is lost when its pool has no member for it (real: allowlist / M1's S_paper493 block; sim: no admitted replacement)

other_sets_apart.why: only S_new, S_newmains and S_paper493 have both sides (0d item 7); S_old's sim count is partial (A25 primary_v3 predates the chain manifests: only its q4b eval-upload rows and the A25 fill-in are counted)
